'''Orbital Reserve''' was a unit in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Orawn]] was a member of the Orbital Reserve.
